elements.name: Screens
elements.responsibility: Swing windows for citizens and operators; call the controllers and pick report categories

elements.name: Use-case controllers
elements.responsibility: one controller per use case plus the SystemServicesController facade; ask the data services for report and user data

elements.name: Data services
elements.responsibility: ReportService and UserService: load, save and update entities through the persistence access

elements.name: Persisted entities
elements.responsibility: JPA entities and embeddables stored in the database: users, reports, locations, categories, status updates, internal notes, notifications

elements.name: Report status states
elements.responsibility: state classes of a report; rebuilt from the stored status string, not persisted

elements.name: Persistence access
elements.responsibility: generic find, save and update over the JPA persistence unit (MySQL reports_db)

concern_details.detail: Which parts of the application depend on persisted information
relationships among users, reports, locations, categories, states, state changes, notes, notifications
concern_details.not_answered: attribute-level relationships belong to a class view (see GR10-Q3); here the entities are one package

concern_details.detail: information persisted across a report's lifecycle

omitted.name: Individual GUI and controller classes
omitted.reason: grouped into packages at balanced level

omitted.name: Persistence access -> Persisted entities
omitted.reason: PersistenceService is generic over entity classes; only the persistence unit lists them

omitted.name: Controllers -> Persisted entities beyond ReportCategory
omitted.reason: controllers reach entity data only through the data services
